editorial.evidence: Re-review on 16 Nov 2026. Dumped all 53 captured sections (tables as rows) and compared them item by item with the previous casebook.md, which was a thin consolidation with generic per-row evidence. Missing before and now restored: the main-guide question table with 'what it's really asking', the non-functional target table and interview-shortcut quote, the eight-step architecture walk, the three-decisions table, the seven-row failure playbook, the weak/average/strong answer tiers, the claims-by-region and 'Show me the numbers' examples, the riskiest-assumption quote (the old follow-up table pointed to 'section 5' without it), the four measurement buckets and layered dashboard, the configuration/adapter/shared-service/core split, the 90-second summary, 2-minute answer, nine carrying lines, five weak-answer repairs, six scoring dimensions, the four cost verbs, the full Quick review (failures table, case numbers, interview close, 14 takeaways) and the brief's six-step Q3-revenue trace, variants table, objectives and audience. Wrong before and fixed: three tables carried the wrong captions (the risk table was captioned as the configuration split, the LangGraph table as results), all five drill figures sat in one run under one generic caption away from their drills, the cost table had blank headers, the em-dash cell rendered as a stray comma and abbr titles carried ' ,  ' artefacts. Restructured into 13 walkthrough steps and 7 deep dives, each drill now beside its own figure; 33 worked-answer reveals now hold every source question, follow-up, repair, trade-off and spoken answer. Source examples labelled: the 3-8 s, 60%, 20% and 4.2/5 figures are labelled source examples. Added illustrative examples are labelled (41.2 vs 42 million summary mismatch, orders-to-shipments fan-out). First-person engagement narration is attributed to the source author. The brief opens on the slide-ready number and the revenue-meaning risk, defines semantic layer, grain, KPI, AST, RLS/CLS and golden case before use, and traces the source's own example before stating the task. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): governance beat announced five pieces but listed four → all five listed, model gateway taken from the deep-dive summary, in both the dive and the story-structure reveal; rollout figure four phases vs guide five steps → five stages taught (guide, requirements 'then a small executive audience' and the week plan all agree), caption says the diagram folds the executive release into one step; 'three boundaries' plus two rules → registry reuse kept inside the consistency boundary and partitioning introduced as a rule beside the three; supervisor figure nine boxes for eight nodes and unconditional clarify → eight nodes named (routing is a conditional edge, drawn as a box) and the clarify-below-60% rule stated, with one neutral sentence on what the diagram draws. 20 November 2026: complete maintained-baseline review and targeted repairs; see .website_spec/casebook-review-2026-11-20/nl-over-governed-data/audit.json. Browser and visual evidence is recorded separately.
